title: Bulgarian St. Stephen Church
scope: The standing Bulgarian St. Stephen Iron Church on the Golden Horn after its 2018 restoration. The church includes the entrance bell tower, five-sided apse, short transept, zinc sheet roof, iron-clad three-aisle nave and cast ornament.
limitations: The standing church uses the mapped footprint. The 1895 engineering publication reports 32 m overall, whereas the named current wall outline is about 27 m from the front to the apse. The mapped walls and the separately modeled approach steps govern placement.
The engineering report gives a 30 m tower including the cross. Lower roof and façade heights, the small cast pinnacles, rosette and swag profiles, colours and ornamental spacing are estimated.

The B&W periodical depicts the iron shell before shipment. Modern landscaping, yard buildings and furnishings are outside model scope. The restored paint and metal roof use approximate neutral colours identified by conservation research.
